exposure: pathogenic variants in glycosylphosphatidylinositol anchor pathway (GPI-AP) genes
variants in synthesis stage genes of the GPI-AP
variants in transamidase and remodelling stage genes of the GPI-AP
outcome: symmetric restricted diffusion of the central tegmental tracts
cohort: The study included 83 individuals from 75 unique families diagnosed with inherited glycosylphosphatidylinositol deficiency disorders (IGDs).
finding: The study expands both the mild and severe phenotypic extremities of IGDs, provides insights into their neurological basis, and enables meaningful genetic counselling for affected individuals and their families.
